title: Contract Extraction Schema
description: Core fields to extract from each bilingual (Arabic/English) contract.

parties.description: The legal entities or individuals entering into the contract, including their roles (e.g., buyer/seller, employer/employee).

effective_date.description: The date on which the contract becomes legally effective, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) when determinable.

duration.description: The term or duration of the contract, including renewal conditions if specified.
duration.example: 24 months from the effective date, automatically renewable for successive 12-month periods unless terminated with 60 days' notice.

financial_value.description: The total monetary value of the contract, including currency and payment terms if stated.

example.payment_terms: Payable in four equal quarterly installments.

termination_clauses.description: Conditions and procedures under which either party may terminate the contract.
example: Either party may terminate with 30 days' written notice.
Immediate termination is permitted in the event of material breach not cured within 15 days.

penalty_clauses.description: Financial or contractual penalties triggered by breach, delay, or non-performance.
example: A penalty of 1% of the contract value per week of delay, up to a maximum of 10%.

governing_law.description: The jurisdiction and legal system that governs interpretation and enforcement of the contract.
governing_law.example: Laws of the United Arab Emirates, with exclusive jurisdiction of the Dubai courts.

language_precedence_clause.description: Which language version (Arabic or English) prevails in case of conflict or discrepancy between the two versions, if such a clause exists in the contract.
language_precedence_clause.example: In case of any conflict or discrepancy between the Arabic and English versions, the Arabic version shall prevail.
